# transcripts-mcp

> Local stdio MCP server that queries Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex session transcripts already on disk.

- Site: https://transcriptsmcp.dev/
- Privacy: https://transcriptsmcp.dev/privacy/
- FAQ: https://transcriptsmcp.dev/faq/
- Source: https://github.com/Stormix/transcripts-mcp
- License: MIT

Each harness already writes JSONL as you work. Point any MCP client at this server to list sessions, open one, or search across them. Nothing is uploaded. The server only reads local files, plus an optional search index under ~/.transcripts-mcp.

## Tools

- list_providers: which of Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex are installed, and how many session files each has
- list_sessions: recent sessions, newest first (summaries only)
- get_transcript: the messages in one session
- grep_transcripts: search the raw files (literal, regex, or fuzzy). No index required
- search_transcripts: ranked search over an index. Hybrid mode after a semantic build
- build_index: create or refresh the search index

## Search tiers

1. grep: scan the raw session files immediately
2. full-text: ranked results after build_index
3. semantic: search by meaning on top of full-text (build_index --semantic)
